title: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores the page argument and always returns the full leaderboard
evidence:
+pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page(
+  store: DemoStore,
+  vacancy_id: String,
+  _page: Int,
+  on_response: fn(Result(LeaderboardResponse, ApiError)) -> msg,
+) -> Effect(msg) {
+  case demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id) {
detail: UserClickedLoadMoreApplications passes model.leaderboard_page + 1, but the page is discarded and the full entry list returned with total = list.length(entries). Any append-style response handler will duplicate every row on 'load more'.
recommended_fix: Slice entries by page and return the real total, or remove/disable the load-more path in demo and document that pagination is out of scope.

title: create_vacancy derives ids purely from an 8-char property-name slug; identical names collide despite the comment
evidence:
+/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric,
+/// up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide.
+fn id_suffix(value: String) -> String {
...
+  let suffix = id_suffix(payload.property_name)
+  let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix
detail: Two demo vacancies created with the same (or same-first-8-chars) property name get identical ids and short_codes; every id-keyed mutation uses list.map over v.vacancy.id == vacancy_id, so both rows mutate at once. The doc comment claims the opposite.
recommended_fix: Mix a per-store counter or existing-id check into the suffix, or change the comment and reject duplicate property names in the demo create path.

title: mark_opened claims idempotency but change_status rewrites status and appends an audit row on every call
evidence:
+/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application to UnderReview
+/// and returns the post-transition status slug.
+pub fn mark_opened(
...
+                    audit_trail: list.append(app.audit_trail, [
+                      AuditEntry(
detail: change_status applies the target status unconditionally and appends a new AuditEntry each call. A second open duplicates the audit entry, and opening an already-Approved application silently regresses it to UnderReview. Not idempotent.
recommended_fix: No-op (return current slug, no audit entry) unless the application is Submitted; only transition Submitted -> UnderReview.

title: archive/restore/close/change_status/refcheck return Ok for unknown ids while update/publish properly fail
detail: archive_vacancy, restore_vacancy, close_vacancy, change_status and refcheck_action_with_contact always return Ok even when no row matched, so the UI shows success for a no-op. update_vacancy/publish_vacancy use find_vacancy and can fail. Inconsistent contract.
recommended_fix: Return Error(Nil) when no vacancy/application/call matched, matching update_vacancy's find_vacancy-based Result.

title: Hardcoded send_reminder result #(2, 1) contradicts the v-maples awaiting pool it reports on
detail: v-maples has three awaiting applicants: one with reminded: False (remindable = 1) and one with followup_due: True, yet send_reminder reports (2, 1) — and returns that for every vacancy, including those whose static_awaiting pool is empty.
recommended_fix: Compute the returned counts from static_awaiting(vacancy_id) (reminded == False / followup_due == True) instead of hardcoding #(2, 1).

title: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite return the store unchanged — reminders never persist
detail: Unlike every other store mutation, these return the input store untouched, so reminded flags never flip and the awaiting section keeps showing the same unreminded applicants after a 'successful' send. demo_api then discards even that tuple (let _ = next).
recommended_fix: Flip reminded/followed_up flags (and append awaiting rows for bulk invite) in the returned store, or document that reminder state is intentionally static.

title: reset_demo swallows seed failures with a silent no-op, contradicting the store's 'never a silent empty demo' guarantee
detail: demo_store.seed's doc says a decode failure is 'a hard error (the drift guard) - never a silent empty demo', but reset_demo's Error arm returns the model unchanged with no toast and no navigation — the user clicks Reset and nothing happens.
recommended_fix: On seed error, show a brand-voice error toast or exit demo mode instead of returning #(model, effect.none()).

title: demo_update header claims the lint bans network imports from demo/, but demo_api imports gleam/fetch and rsvp
evidence:
+//// No network: every effect here comes from `demo/demo_api.gleam`, which
+//// dispatches synchronously — the CI grep lint bans network imports from
+//// `demo/`.
...
+import gleam/fetch
+import gleam/http/request
detail: demo_api.gleam (also in demo/) imports gleam/fetch, rsvp and gleam/http/request under its own documented static-asset exception. demo_update's header states the ban unqualified, contradicting the sibling module's carve-out.
recommended_fix: Qualify the header, e.g. 'the CI grep lint bans network imports from demo/ except demo_api's documented static-PDF fetch'.

title: for_edit reports updated_at: vac.created_at and update_vacancy never bumps any timestamp
evidence:
+    total_applications: list.length(v.applications),
+    status: vac.status,
+    updated_at: vac.created_at,
+  ))
detail: After a demo edit, the edit screen's updated_at still shows the creation timestamp; update_vacancy only spreads ..old and stores no updated field, so edits are invisible on any 'last updated' surface.
recommended_fix: Track an updated_at on DemoVacancy set to the demo 'now' (2026-08-19) in update_vacancy and derive for_edit's updated_at from it.

title: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
detail: If demo_store is ever None while demo_mode is True, each handler call re-seeds independently and mutations are silently dropped between messages. An 'unreachable' fallback that misbehaves when reached is worse than a loud failure.
recommended_fix: Write the seeded store back into the returned model, or make the fallback visibly loud (error toast) since reaching it is already a bug.

title: Approval refetches the leaderboard post-mutation with an explanatory comment; rejection/backward transitions don't
evidence:
+    UserConfirmedApproval(vid, aid) -> {
+      let #(updated, eff) = demo_status(model, vid, aid, "approved")
+      // Refetch the leaderboard from the POST-mutation store so the approved
+      // applicant's row reflects the new status (the pre-mutation store
+      // would leave them under-review).
detail: Rejection and backward transitions change the same leaderboard-visible status field but skip the refetch. If the response handler doesn't refetch (not visible in this chunk), those rows render stale; if it does, the approval refetch is redundant.
recommended_fix: Make all three paths consistent: either rely on the ApiReturnedStatusUpdate handler to refetch, or refetch in each confirm arm.

title: status_from_slug maps any unknown slug to Submitted
detail: A typo or newly added status string silently becomes Submitted while change_status still returns Ok(original slug), so the store records Submitted while the UI believes the requested status was applied.
recommended_fix: Return Result(ApplicationStatus, Nil) from status_from_slug and surface an error for unknown slugs instead of defaulting.
